name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.poster.view.PosterEditActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the editor for a selected promotional poster. It adds the user's name, referral code, and QR code, then lets the user save or share the image.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from customizing and sharing referral posters.
